summary: Bind approved trigger-output science sources without treating disabled recipes as production proof.
details: Recognize a named disabled science recipe only when its same-named enabled technology uses a send-item-to-orbit trigger whose exact item has a positive typed rocket-launch product for that pack and the recipe has no unlock-recipe effect.

Keep the trigger technology prerequisites as required approved-reference dependencies. Explicit owners remain on the existing direct-owner path; mismatched, zero, disabled, cyclic, unseeded, and separately owned alternatives remain unresolved.

This fixes the native Space Age space-science source fact used by the downstream cryogenic-science chain. It does not establish rocket acquisition, factory feasibility, a current-engine native qualification, or a performance result.
